items.name: Mandarin orange / clementine (whole, unpeeled)
items.preparation: raw, whole with peel on; edible mass excludes peel (whole fruit roughly 100 g)

scale_cues: Square white plate assumed about 25-26 cm across; the fruit spans roughly a third of the plate width, giving a diameter of about 6-6.5 cm. Overhead camera rig frame also used as a rough reference.
assumptions: Fruit is a mandarin/clementine rather than a small orange, judged by its size, slightly flattened shape and loose-looking peel
Fruit is whole and unpeeled; grams are the edible portion only, taken as about 74% of whole-fruit weight
Pinkish smears and the small dark speck on the plate are residue from earlier food, not a loggable item
Plate size is assumed, not measured, so the fruit's size could be off by 15-20%
